title: Multi-modal Representation Fusion for Long-term Microsurgical Anastomosis Trajectory Anticipation
summary: Microsurgical anastomosis is one of the most challenging and sophisticated procedures for surgical robotics, requiring accurate manipulation of surgical instruments within a limited space to achieve precise operations. Accurate surgical trajectory anticipation is essential for surgical scene understanding, intraoperative planning, robotic manipulation, and reliable behaviour analysis. However, existing approaches mainly focus on features extracted from surgical videos and historical trajectories, while overlooking rich semantic and motion information that can provide more discriminative multi-modal representations for complex surgical instrument-tissue interactions. In this work, we propose a cross-modal feature fusion framework for long-term 2D and 3D microsurgical anastomosis trajectory anticipation. The proposed framework consists of a multi-modal representation extractor and a cross-modal feature fusion network. Semantic recognition of surgical objects and consecutive motion estimation are incorporated as multi-modal visual cues, providing complementary spatial and temporal guidance for instrument-tissue interaction characterization. A coarse-to-fine progressive fusion strategy with a long-short-term memory mechanism is introduced to capture temporal dependencies step by step. The training and evaluation are conducted on our established robotic platform and a comprehensive dataset containing both phantom and ex-vivo surgical scenarios is constructed. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms existing methods and exhibits improved robustness across different surgical scenes, highlighting its potential for both intelligent robot-assisted and autonomous surgical systems.
tldr: Proposes a cross-modal feature fusion framework for long-term 2D/3D microsurgical anastomosis trajectory anticipation, combining semantic recognition and motion estimation via a coarse-to-fine progressive fusion with LSTM, validated on phantom and ex-vivo robotic datasets.
tldr_zh: 提出一种面向显微外科吻合术长期2D/3D轨迹预测的跨模态特征融合框架，融合语义识别与运动估计，通过由粗到细的渐进式融合和LSTM建模时序依赖，并在仿真与离体手术数据集上验证。
summary_zh: 显微外科吻合是外科机器人最具挑战性和精细度的操作之一，要求在有限空间内精准操控手术器械以实现精确操作。准确的手术轨迹预测对于手术场景理解、术中规划、机器人操控以及可靠的行为分析至关重要。然而，现有方法主要关注从手术视频和历史轨迹中提取特征，而忽略了丰富的语义和运动信息，这些信息能够为复杂的手术器械-组织交互提供更具判别性的多模态表示。在本研究中，我们提出了一种用于长期二维和三维显微外科吻合轨迹预测的跨模态特征融合框架。该框架由多模态表示提取器和跨模态特征融合网络组成。手术对象的语义识别和连续运动估计被纳入多模态视觉线索，为器械-组织交互表征提供互补的空间和时间引导。引入了一种结合长短期记忆机制的从粗到细的渐进式融合策略，以逐步捕获时间依赖性。我们在自行搭建的机器人平台上进行了训练和评估，并构建了包含仿真和离体手术场景的综合数据集。大量的定量和定性实验表明，所提出的框架在所有对比方法中持续取得更优性能，并在不同手术场景下展现出更强的鲁棒性，凸显了其在智能机器人辅助和自主手术系统中的潜在应用价值。

title: Observation-Referenced Tissue Deformation Forecasting with Tool-Driven and Residual Dynamics
summary: Forecasting tissue deformation from future instrument motion could support predictive planning and increasingly autonomous surgical systems. We study this problem using a scene-specific differentiable surface model fitted to an observed tool-tissue interaction window. Rather than forecasting absolute simulated positions, we introduce an \textit{observation-referenced} formulation that anchors each tissue point to its last valid observation and adds only the deformation induced by the known, preplanned future tool trajectory. This reduces sensitivity to reconstruction, initialization, and persistent simulation offsets while preserving the predicted deformation response. The physical model uses differentiable, mesh-free position-based dynamics with scene-specific rigidity, attachment, region scale, and grasp coupling. We further introduce an optional \textit{observation-referenced residual model} combining graph-spectral spatial modes with periodic harmonic dynamics for structured motion not explained by the tool input. We evaluate the framework retrospectively on 12 surgical manipulation clips from three datasets. Observation referencing provides the largest gain, with a median within-clip error ratio of $0.598$ relative to the corresponding absolute simulation forecast. The optional periodic residual further improves forecasting when the remaining motion exhibits periodic structure. These results support observation-referenced deformation prediction as a practical building block for future surgical world models, digital twins, and generative simulators that must predict how tissue evolves under instrument actions.
tldr: The paper proposes an observation-referenced, physics-based framework for forecasting tissue deformation from planned future tool motion, combining differentiable position-based dynamics with an optional residual model for periodic motion. Evaluations on surgical clips show that observation referencing substantially improves forecasting accuracy over absolute simulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于观测参照的物理仿真框架，利用可微的位置动力学和可选的周期性残差模型，从未来器械运动预测组织变形。在手术视频片段上的实验表明，观测参照策略显著提升了预测精度。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
根据未来的器械运动预测组织变形，可支持预测性规划以及日益自主化的手术系统。我们利用一个针对场景的、可微分的表面模型来研究这一问题，该模型拟合于观测到的工具-组织交互窗口。我们没有预测绝对模拟位置，而是引入了一种\textit{以观测为参考}的公式，将每个组织点锚定到其最后一次有效观测，并仅添加由已知的、预先规划的器械未来轨迹所引起的变形。这降低了对重建、初始化以及持续仿真偏移的敏感性，同时保留了预测的变形响应。物理模型采用可微分的、无网格的基于位置动力学，并包含场景特定的刚度、附着、区域尺度以及抓取耦合。我们还进一步引入了一个可选的\textit{以观测为参考的残差模型}，将图谱空间模态与周期性谐波动力学相结合，以处理无法由器械输入解释的结构化运动。我们在来自三个数据集的12个手术操作片段上对框架进行了回顾性评估。观测参考带来了最大的性能提升，相对于相应的绝对仿真预测，其片段内中位误差比为$0.598$。当剩余运动呈现周期性结构时，可选的周期性残差进一步改善了预测效果。这些结果支持将观测参考变形预测作为未来手术世界模型、数字孪生以及生成式模拟器的实用构建模块，这些系统必须预测组织在器械作用下的演化过程。

title: PC7 Model: Dynamics of Expanding and Contracting Soft Robots using Piece-wise Constant 7D Deformation Based on Similarity Transformation Group
summary: This paper proposes a novel soft robot model named piece-wise constant 7D deformation (PC7) model that can represent expanding and contracting deformation of, for example, artificial muscle actuator. In the proposed model, we newly define the 7D deformation vector based on SIM(3) - 3D similarity transformation group - whereas a 6D deformation vector was defined for Cosserat rod based on SE(3) - the special Euclid group - in the piece-wise constant strain (PCS) model proposed in the previous study. The additional dimension of the 7D deformation vector represents expanding and contracting deformation, which comes from the scaling parameter in SIM(3). Common mathematical properties between SE(3) and SIM(3) allow us to directly extend the kinematics and dynamics of the PCS model to those of the PC7 model. In particular, we derive the dynamical equation of the PC7 model based on Euler-Poincare equation in a mathematically precise manner. We validate the proposed model through dynamical simulations assuming a thin cylinder structure or McKibben-type artificial muscle actuator.
tldr: The paper proposes a piece-wise constant 7D deformation (PC7) model for soft robots, extending the 6D PCS/Cosserat-rod model by introducing a scaling dimension from SIM(3) to capture expanding/contracting deformations, and derives its dynamics via Euler-Poincaré equation with simulations on a thin cylinder and McKibben artificial muscle.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于软体机器人的分段常值7维形变（PC7）模型，通过在SIM(3)中引入缩放维数，将基于SE(3)的6维PCS/Cosserat杆模型扩展到可描述膨胀/收缩变形，并利用Euler-Poincaré方程推导动力学，在薄圆柱和McKibben人工肌肉上进行了仿真验证。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的软体机器人模型，称为分段常数七维变形（PC7）模型，该模型能够表示例如人工肌肉执行器的膨胀与收缩变形。在所提出的模型中，我们基于SIM(3)——三维相似变换群——新定义了七维变形向量，而先前研究中提出的分段常数应变（PCS）模型则基于SE(3)——特殊欧几里得群——为Cosserat杆定义了六维变形向量。七维变形向量的额外维度表示膨胀与收缩变形，其来源于SIM(3)中的缩放参数。SE(3)与SIM(3)之间共有的数学性质使我们能够直接将PCS模型的运动学与动力学推广至PC7模型。特别地，我们基于欧拉-庞加莱方程以数学上精确的方式推导了PC7模型的动力学方程。我们通过假设薄圆柱结构或McKibben型人工肌肉执行器的动力学仿真来验证所提出的模型。

title: Spatiotemporal Recognition of Abdominal Wall Layers During Optical Trocar Entry
summary: Objective. To evaluate whether spatial context and temporal modeling improve tissue recognition during optical trocar entry, where multiple abdominal-wall tissues may be visible simultaneously. Methods. We retrospectively analyzed 71 recordings with 1,516 annotated keyframes and 29,151 clinician-annotated sectors. Each frame was divided into 28 polar-grid sectors assigned to nine tissue classes. Color, neighboring-sector, and positional features were used by a gradient-boosted emission classifier. The full pipeline added learned temporal smoothing, spatial regularization, an anatomically ordered hidden Markov model, and posterior blending. Five-fold cross-validation was grouped by recording, with cross-fitting to prevent within-recording leakage. Primary evaluation used clinician-derived targets; ablations assessed classification, probability quality, spatial consistency, and peritoneum-or-deeper onset timing. Results. The complete pipeline achieved accuracy 0.646, macro-F1 0.507, and macro-AUROC 0.882, versus 0.600, 0.440, and 0.861 for emissions alone. Macro-F1 improved by 0.066 across all five folds. Label changes decreased from 66.2 to 19.5 per sector-minute, and median onset error decreased from 15.58 to 2.45 seconds. Frames with a tissue-depth-code span of at least three decreased from 53% to 26%, versus 22% for clinician annotations. Performance remained limited for preperitoneal fat and bowel, and the full model retained a 44% premature-onset proportion. Conclusions. Combining appearance, spatial context, and temporal constraints improved retrospective tissue recognition and onset localization. Tissue-specific limitations, residual timing errors, and reliance on future observations warrant external validation and prospective evaluation of causal models before clinical use.
tldr: The paper presents a spatiotemporal recognition pipeline for abdominal-wall tissue layers during optical trocar entry, combining polar-grid sector features, a gradient-boosted classifier, spatial regularization, and an anatomically ordered hidden Markov model. The full model improved tissue classification, spatial consistency, and onset localization compared to emission-only baselines, though residual timing errors and tissue-specific limitations remain.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种在光学穿刺器进入期间识别腹壁组织层的时空识别流程，结合极坐标网格扇区特征、梯度提升分类器、空间正则化和解剖有序隐马尔可夫模型。与仅基于发射概率的基线相比，完整模型在组织分类、空间一致性和起点定位上均有改进，但仍存在残余时序误差和特定组织类型的局限性。
summary_zh:
摘要：
目的：评估空间上下文和时间建模能否提高光学穿刺器置入过程中的组织识别能力，在该过程中可能同时显示多种腹壁组织。方法：我们回顾性分析了71段记录，包含1,516个已标注关键帧和29,151个临床医生标注的扇区。每帧被划分为28个极坐标网格扇区，归为九类组织。梯度提升发射分类器使用颜色、相邻扇区和位置特征。完整流程增加了学习到的时间平滑、空间正则化、解剖顺序隐马尔可夫模型以及后验混合。五折交叉验证按记录分组，并采用交叉拟合以防止记录内泄漏。主要评估使用临床医生标注的目标；消融实验评估了分类性能、概率质量、空间一致性和腹膜或更深层起始时间。结果：完整流程的准确率为0.646，宏F1为0.507，宏AUROC为0.882，而仅使用发射分类器分别为0.600、0.440和0.861。宏F1在所有五折中平均提高了0.066。标签变化从每扇区分钟66.2次降至19.5次，中位起始误差从15.58秒降至2.45秒。组织深度编码跨度至少为3的帧从53%降至26%，而临床医生标注为22%。腹膜前脂肪和肠道的性能仍然有限，完整模型仍有44%的过早起始比例。结论：结合外观、空间上下文和时间约束改善了回顾性组织识别和起始定位。组织特异性局限、残余时间误差以及对未来观测的依赖，需要在临床使用前进行外部验证和因果模型的前瞻性评估。

title: Modeling and Control of a Rigid-soft Hybrid-link Humanoid Robot
summary: Physical flexibility plays a significant role not only in human motions but also in robot motions. For example, a humanoid robot with passive and flexible elements, which can be regarded as a rigid--soft hybrid-link system, has the advantages of storing energy and mitigating impact in a dynamic motion. However, the motion design and control of a hybrid-link system are challenging to achieve and have only been discussed in the literature. In this study, we propose the framework of inverse kinematics and compliance optimization-based control for a hybrid-link humanoid system that represents the continuous deformation of a flexible structure using the piece-wise constant strain (PCS) model. The proposed method was validated using forward dynamics simulations for standing, jumping, and walking motions. Then, we built an experimental setup using a biped humanoid robot with leaf-spring type prosthesis leg, in which the prosthesis deformation was measured by a motion capture system. Using this setup, we experimentally validated the proposed method for standing balance control in both double- and single-support cases.
tldr: This paper proposes an inverse kinematics and compliance optimization-based control framework for rigid-soft hybrid-link humanoid robots, using a piece-wise constant strain model to represent flexible deformation, and validates it through simulations of standing, jumping, walking and physical experiments on a biped with leaf-spring prosthetic legs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向刚柔混合连杆仿人机器人的逆运动学与柔顺优化控制框架，利用分段常应变模型描述柔性变形，并通过站立、跳跃、行走仿真以及带板簧假肢腿的双足机器人实验进行了验证。
summary_zh: 物理柔性不仅在人体运动中起着重要作用，在机器人运动中也同样重要。例如，带有被动柔性元件的人形机器人可被视为刚柔混合连杆系统，其在动态运动中具有储存能量和缓冲冲击的优势。然而，混合连杆系统的运动设计与控制具有挑战性，且目前仅在文献中有所讨论。本研究提出了一种基于逆运动学和顺应优化控制的框架，用于刚柔混合人形系统，该系统采用分段常应变（PCS）模型来描述柔性结构的连续变形。通过站立、跳跃和行走运动的前向动力学仿真验证了所提方法。随后，我们搭建了实验平台，使用带有板簧型假肢腿的双足人形机器人，并通过运动捕捉系统测量假肢变形。利用该平台，我们在双支撑和单支撑两种情况下实验验证了所提方法在站立平衡控制中的有效性。

title: Toward System One Clinical Intelligence: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Counterfactual Explainability of Decision Foundation Models
summary: Automated disease classification from patient-reported symptoms requires balancing the speed of lightweight discriminative models against the contextual understanding and latency costs of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Decision foundation models offer an alternative by mapping representations directly to candidate classes without free-form text generation. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion-parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, for 24-class disease classification on the Symptom2Disease benchmark. Using 4-bit quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) with differential learning rates and a stratified split of 960 training and 240 test cases, the model achieves 95.42% diagnostic accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.9551. This improves upon the reported zero-shot baselines of 61.67% for a remote API and 65.00% for a local unadapted initialization, and outperforms the ClinicalBERT baseline (90.90%). By evaluating candidate logits in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding, inference takes under 80 milliseconds per record on a single GPU, yielding a reported 31-fold speedup over generative LLM baselines. To examine symptom-level evidence, we introduce a Leave-One-Symptom-Out (LOSO) counterfactual perturbation framework. Removing disease-defining symptom clauses in a psoriasis example reduces predicted-class confidence from 100.00% to 0.12% and shifts the prediction to impetigo with 99.59% confidence, while removing secondary systemic symptoms produces less than 0.01% change in confidence. These findings suggest that decision-based architectures can combine the linguistic capabilities of large foundation models with low-latency inference and symptom-level interpretability for clinical triage.
tldr: This paper adapts the 9-billion-parameter decision foundation model Clef-Flash to 24-class disease classification from symptoms using QLoRA, achieving 95.42% accuracy and under 80 ms inference per record, and introduces a Leave-One-Symptom-Out counterfactual framework for symptom-level explainability.
tldr_zh: 该论文将基于Qwen3.5的90亿参数决策基础模型Clef-Flash通过QLoRA适配到24类症状疾病分类，取得95.42%准确率，并在单GPU上实现每次记录低于80毫秒的推理，同时提出留一症状消除（LOSO）反事实解释方法。
summary_zh:
摘要：
从患者报告的症状中进行自动疾病分类，需要在轻量级判别模型的速度与自回归大语言模型（LLM）的上下文理解能力及延迟成本之间取得平衡。决策基础模型提供了一种替代方案，它将表示直接映射到候选类别，而无需生成自由文本。我们将Clef-Flash（一个基于Qwen3.5骨干网络的90亿参数决策模型）适配到Symptom2Disease基准上的24类疾病分类任务。采用4位量化低秩适配（QLoRA）、差异化学习率以及960个训练样本和240个测试样本的分层划分，该模型实现了95.42%的诊断准确率和0.9551的宏F1分数。这一结果优于远程API报告的61.67%零样本基线和本地未适配初始化的65.00%基线，并超过了ClinicalBERT基线（90.90%）。由于在单次前向传播中评估候选logits而无需自回归解码，在单个GPU上每条记录的推理时间不到80毫秒，相较生成式LLM基线实现了31倍的加速。为了检查症状级证据，我们引入了留一症状法（LOSO）反事实扰动框架。在银屑病示例中，移除疾病定义性症状描述会使预测类别置信度从100.00%降至0.12%，并将预测转移至脓疱疮（置信度99.59%），而移除次要全身性症状则使置信度变化小于0.01%。这些发现表明，基于决策的架构可以将大型基础模型的语言能力与低延迟推理和症状级可解释性相结合，适用于临床分诊。

title: Lingdan-V2: Large language models for clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine
summary: Large language models have advanced medical reasoning, but clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) remains challenging because prescription decisions require integrating domain knowledge, syndrome differentiation, treatment principles, herbal prescription composition, and dosage determination. We develop a TCM language model family comprising models with 4 billion, 8 billion, and 14 billion parameters. The artificial intelligence contribution is a staged clinical alignment framework integrating large scale continued pretraining on TCM and clinical records, complementary reasoning supervision, and prescription-centered reinforcement learning (RL). We further formulate herbal prescription generation as a structured RL problem with prescription-level feedback, enabling direct optimization of clinical decision outputs beyond knowledge reproduction and generic instruction following. The engineering application is TCM clinical decision support, particularly herbal prescription recommendation. We evaluate the models on a public benchmark containing 25,620 expert-verified items across 13 TCM knowledge and clinical reasoning tasks and on a private retrospective dataset of 4,348 spleen and stomach disease prescription cases. The 14 billion parameter reinforcement aligned model achieves a prescription generation F1 of 37.0 on the public benchmark, compared with 32.3 for DeepSeek-R1 with 671 billion total parameters, and a herb-level F1 of 52.8 on the clinical dataset with improved dosage agreement. Reinforcement post-training consistently improves prescription recommendation across all scales, while physician-source analysis shows that expert heterogeneity affects reward stability. These findings demonstrate a scalable pathway from domain grounding and reasoning supervision to clinically oriented prescription decision support.
tldr: Lingdan-V2 introduces a family of TCM large language models (4B/8B/14B) trained with a staged clinical alignment framework combining TCM continued pretraining, complementary reasoning supervision, and prescription-centered reinforcement learning. The largest model achieves state-of-the-art herbal prescription generation on public and private clinical benchmarks, outperforming DeepSeek-R1 in prescription F1 while using far fewer parameters.
tldr_zh: Lingdan-V2 提出了面向中医临床推理的大语言模型系列（4B/8B/14B），采用分阶段临床对齐框架，结合中医继续预训练、补充推理监督和以处方为中心的强化学习。其中140亿参数模型在公开和私有临床基准上的处方生成F1超过DeepSeek-R1，同时参数量远小于后者。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型已推动医学推理的进步，但中医临床推理仍具挑战性，因为处方决策需要整合领域知识、辨证论治、治则治法、方剂组成及剂量确定。我们开发了一个中医语言模型家族，包含40亿、80亿和140亿参数规模的模型。人工智能方面的贡献在于提出了一种分阶段临床对齐框架，该框架整合了大规模中医与临床病历的持续预训练、互补式推理监督以及以处方为中心的强化学习（RL）。我们进一步将草药处方生成形式化为一个具有处方级反馈的结构化强化学习问题，从而能够直接优化临床决策输出，超越知识复现和通用指令跟随。工程应用方面，该系统用于中医临床决策支持，尤其是草药处方推荐。我们在一个包含13项中医知识与临床推理任务、共25,620个专家审核条目的公开基准上，以及一个包含4,348例脾胃病处方病例的私有回顾性数据集上评估了模型。140亿参数强化对齐模型在公开基准上的处方生成F1值达37.0，而参数总量达6,710亿的DeepSeek-R1为32.3；在临床数据集上的草药级F1值达52.8，且剂量一致性有所提高。强化后训练在所有规模上均持续改善处方推荐性能，而医师来源分析表明，专家异质性会影响奖励稳定性。这些发现展示了一条从领域基础与推理监督走向临床导向处方决策支持的可扩展路径。

title: Text-Guided Medical Image Segmentation via Residual Aggregation and Dense Alignment Representations
summary: Specifying segmentation targets with natural language provides flexible semantic conditioning for medical image segmentation. However, existing methods still struggle to reliably ground high-level textual semantics into accurate pixel-level spatial prompts, especially under low-contrast lesions, ambiguous boundaries, and visually similar anatomical contexts. In this paper, we propose RADAR (Residual Aggregation and Dense Alignment Representations), a parameter-efficient framework for text-guided medical image segmentation. RADAR explicitly decouples and synergizes the medical semantic anchoring capability of BiomedCLIP with the prompt-driven mask decoding ability of MedSAM2, while enabling low-cost task adaptation via LoRA. Specifically, Guided Residual Depth Aggregation adaptively aggregates cross-layer features under semantic guidance to alleviate delayed textual injection and deep semantic dilution. Structured Dense Representation Alignment leverages a frozen BiomedCLIP to construct crop-level target, boundary, and context anchors, improving the local discriminability of dense features and the reliability of automatic prompts. Multi-modal Prompt Generation further converts cross-modal semantic responses into composite text, point, and mask prompts for MedSAM2 decoding. Experiments on three public medical image segmentation datasets show that RADAR achieves competitive performance with only 0.74M trainable parameters, demonstrating its effectiveness in parameter-efficient adaptation, semantic grounding, and dense representation enhancement. The source code is available at https://github.com/JGuiidev/RADAR.
tldr: Proposes RADAR, a parameter-efficient framework for text-guided medical image segmentation that combines BiomedCLIP's semantic anchoring with MedSAM2's mask decoding via LoRA, residual aggregation, dense alignment, and multi-modal prompt generation; achieves competitive results with only 0.74M trainable parameters.
tldr_zh: 提出RADAR，一种参数高效的文本引导医学图像分割框架，结合BiomedCLIP语义锚定与MedSAM2掩码解码，通过LoRA、残差聚合、密集对齐和多模态提示生成，以0.74M可训练参数取得有竞争力的性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：
使用自然语言指定分割目标可为医学图像分割提供灵活的语义条件约束。然而，现有方法在将高层文本语义可靠地锚定到精确的像素级空间提示方面仍面临挑战，尤其是在低对比度病灶、模糊边界以及视觉相似的解剖背景下。本文提出RADAR（残差聚合与密集对齐表示，Residual Aggregation and Dense Alignment Representations），一种用于文本引导医学图像分割的参数高效框架。RADAR显式解耦并协同了BiomedCLIP的医学语义锚定能力与MedSAM2的提示驱动掩码解码能力，同时通过LoRA实现低成本任务适配。具体而言，引导式残差深度聚合在语义引导下自适应聚合跨层特征，以缓解文本注入延迟和深层语义稀释问题。结构化密集表示对齐利用冻结的BiomedCLIP构建裁剪级目标、边界和上下文锚点，提升密集特征的局部判别性以及自动提示的可靠性。多模态提示生成进一步将跨模态语义响应转换为复合的文本、点和掩码提示，供MedSAM2解码。在三个公开的医学图像分割数据集上的实验表明，RADAR仅凭0.74M可训练参数即可达到具有竞争力的性能，验证了其在参数高效适配、语义锚定和密集表示增强方面的有效性。源代码可在 https://github.com/JGuiidev/RADAR 获取。

title: ScienceBuddy-PV: A Verifier-Governed Recursive Improvement Protocol for Panvascular Intervention Research
summary: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convolutional model was trained once per representation setting; its parameters and the heuristic support gate were then held fixed, with the stenosis threshold selected on validation data. On the locked test sets, syntax Dice was 0.475 (95% CI 0.459-0.490) and stenosis Dice was 0.231 (95% CI 0.214-0.249). Stenosis pixel AUROC was 0.957 and AUPRC was 0.180 at prevalence 0.00975. The gate accepted 76.7% of stenosis-frame outputs versus 100% for a score-only comparator. In a constructed mask audit, it accepted 44.3% of reference candidates and rejected 55.7%, exposing the cost of abstention. Acceptance does not establish correctness or clinical safety. This public-data component audit makes support and abstention measurable and provides a reproducible protocol for future collaborative agent studies. It does not demonstrate recursive improvement, patient-level validity or clinical device recommendations.
tldr: ScienceBuddy-PV proposes a verifier-governed recursive improvement protocol for panvascular intervention research, but only audits a fixed component on public ARCADE stenosis/syntax tasks, reporting modest segmentation Dice and no executed recursive improvement or patient-level validation.
tldr_zh: ScienceBuddy-PV 提出了一个由验证者控制的递归改进协议用于泛血管介入研究，但仅在公共数据集上审计了固定组件，报告了中等的分割Dice，并未执行所声称的递归改进或患者级验证。
summary_zh: ScienceBuddy-PV将ScienceBuddy的递归式设计应用于泛血管介入研究，通过结构化证据账本、器械-血管本体、弃权契约和保留失败库实现。递归优化框架和外层循环模型学习（包括强化学习）已明确但未执行。我们使用独立的ARCADE语法和狭窄任务（每个任务1,000张训练图像、200张验证图像和300张测试图像）对固定组件而非完整智能体系统进行了审计。共享的任务掩蔽卷积模型每种表示设置仅训练一次；其参数和启发式支持门随后保持固定，狭窄阈值在验证数据上选取。在锁定测试集上，语法Dice为0.475（95% CI 0.459-0.490），狭窄Dice为0.231（95% CI 0.214-0.249）。狭窄像素AUROC为0.957，AUPRC为0.180，患病率为0.00975。该门接受了76.7%的狭窄帧输出，而仅基于评分的比较器为100%。在构建的掩膜审计中，它接受了44.3%的参考候选，拒绝了55.7%，暴露了弃权的代价。接受并不确立正确性或临床安全性。这项公开数据组件审计使支持和弃权具备可度量性，并为未来协作性智能体研究提供了可重复的协议。它未展示递归改进、患者级有效性或临床器械建议。
